artifact: SFEB MON-006 SCITT-compatible action evidence and COSE receipts v1

benchmark.scope: same-process built-in CBOR/Ed25519/Merkle CPU only; no network, persistence, live TS, external sink or independent readback; not an industry benchmark

wire_shape: CBOR tag 18 COSE_Sign1; EdDSA -8; protected content_type, kid, CWT iss/sub; two separate mock TS COSE receipt structures with VDS=1 and inclusion proof type -1 at header 396; receipts attached at label 394
limitations: No live SCITT Transparency Service API or external service was contacted.
CBOR parser/encoder is a strict deterministic subset for the exercised structures, not a general RFC 8949 implementation.
No independent cross-implementation COSE/SCITT differential test was run.
Issuer and TS keys are deterministic fixtures, not production KMS/HSM keys.
Both TSs are mock logs in one process, not independently operated services.
No key rotation/revocation, trust-policy governance, network gossip, source/authority service, external mutation sink or independent readback exists.
application/sfeb-action-evidence+cbor is a prototype media type and not a published SFEB profile.
A transparency receipt establishes signer provenance and VDS inclusion, not the truth of the action statement.
